Job Title: Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Functional (SME)Job Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Functional Subject Matter Expert to provide cross‑module design authority for the OPM Modernization Program—one of the most significant federal HCM transformation initiatives underway. This modernization effort is migrating legacy HR systems to Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM for the U.S. civilian federal workforce.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape enterprise‑wide SaaS HCM configurations, influence federal HR policy translation, and guide the implementation of modern HR services supporting federal employees and their families. You will define functional direction across modules, establish security architecture, and safeguard the enterprise design while partnering closely with government stakeholders and implementation teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide functional design authority across Core HCM, Federal HR, Absence Management, Time & Labor, Learning, and Benefits, ensuring consistency across all modules.

  • Translate federal HR policy—including Title 5, Title 38, GPPA, and OPM regulations—into Oracle Fusion Cloud configuration decisions; adjudicate requirements and resolve functional conflicts.

  • Guide the design of federal benefits programs such as FEHB, FERS, CSRS, TSP, and FEGLI.

  • Establish compensation and pay architecture supporting GS, SES, Wage Grade, Title 38 pay plans, and other federal workforce pay systems.

  • Govern Time & Attendance solution design including leave accrual rules, premium pay, AWS, and FLSA compliance.

  • Own the Oracle Fusion Application Security architecture, including Job, Data, and Duty roles, privilege modeling, segregation‑of‑duties controls, and Security Console governance.

  • Define data migration validation strategy and approve approaches for reconciling legacy source systems.

  • Set functional testing strategy for UAT and parallel payroll validation; approve test coverage for all modules.

  • Govern standards for functional documentation, configuration workbooks, and training material development.

  • Direct integration design with federal systems such as EHRI, eOPF, USA Staffing, and payroll providers in collaboration with technical architects.

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for federal HR policy interpretation and enterprise HR system design.

  • Mentor functional consultants, review design artifacts across modules, and provide guidance on design coherence.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including PI Planning, sprint reviews, and backlog refinement; influence roadmap priorities.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

  • Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • 7+ years of hands‑on experience configuring Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM (or Oracle EBS HR) including cross‑module leadership on enterprise implementations.

  • Expertise across multiple HCM functional domains: Core HCM, Federal HR, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Time & Labor, and/or Learning.

  • Deep knowledge of federal HR regulations and pay systems including Title 5, Title 38, and associated authorities.

  • Proven experience designing and governing Oracle Fusion Application Security, including role design, privilege management, least‑privilege models, and segregation‑of‑duties.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience translating enterprise HR requirements into coherent architectural solutions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience leading discussions with executive stakeholders.

Desired:

  • Oracle HCM Cloud certification (multi‑domain preferred).

  • Experience with federal HR programs: FEHB, FERS/CSRS, TSP, FEGLI, GS/SES pay, Title 38 pay systems.

  • Extensive experience with SF‑50 processing, GPPA guidelines, and OPM reporting.

  • Proficiency with Oracle tools: FSM, HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, BI Publisher, Security Console.

  • Advanced Agile certification (SAFe Agilist, SAFe Architect, or equivalent).

  • Experience supporting federal civilian or DoD HCM implementations.

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$105,100-$231,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Xage is looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager with in-depth knowledge of Industrial Control System, Industrial networking, Identity and Access Management, Privilege Access, and experience of working in large projects. The responsibility of this role is to provide our customers with technical expertise and professional services to make sure they are meeting their objectives.
Strong technical presentation, communication and influencing skills are required to collaborate with clients, market leaders, geography leaders, and security sales representatives to motivate current and emerging services. In this role you are responsible for delivering client value through quality deliverables of Xage’s cybersecurity services portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to clients, assessing, implementing, and delivering customized integrations and workflows based on knowledge of the industry, ICS best practices, project requirements, and the client's business objectives.
  • Be the first line of defense in solving customer support requests and coordinating and prioritizing timely resolutions with engineering teams.
  • Provide training and coaching to customers on how to establish and manage their Xage Security solutions deployment.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of typical business challenges faced by customers and common objectives to appropriately map features and associated business benefits to address their needs.

  • Work with customers and internal stakeholders to define technical solutions that meet customer use cases and requirements using a combination of internal and in some cases 3rd party software/hardware/tools.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to establish strong client relationships with key accounts, particularly within the federal sector, by demonstrating technical expertise and a deep understanding of client needs to help progress organic growth.
  • Identity gaps in product functionality and flexibility and proactively work with product management and engineering organizations to address these gaps using a combination of internal R&D and technology/product partnerships.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 3+ years of experience in developing cybersecurity solutions and services, with a focus on IAM/PAM, ICS environments, and network security.

Additional Requirements

  • Self-motivated and results focused; ability to strengthen the team and its mission.
  • Ability to travel based on the needs of the business. Up to 30%.

Remote, Latam or Europe, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +4 years of experience

Who We Are

At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team! If you are a Lead Product Designer ambitious and passionate about building world-class payment experiences, joining Yuno will allow you to transform complex problems into simple, elegant solutions that reach millions of users across the globe. At Yuno, every design decision impacts the payment revolution.

As a Lead Product Designer you will be part of the Product Team, working end-to-end from discovery through delivery always with the customer at the center.

Your contribution will be

  • Lead the design process from discovery to delivery, owning the full end-to-end experience across web and mobile platforms.

  • Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, and Data Scientists to deeply understand customer needs and define the right problems to solve.

  • Identify key metrics for your projects and take ownership of their success, iterating based on real performance data.

  • Research and bring forward user insights to support product launches in new markets and the rollout of new payment features.

  • Design clear, elegant solutions from early wireframes and concepts through to polished, production-ready prototypes and flows.

  • Run customer testing workshops to validate assumptions and ensure designs solve real problems before going to build.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers during implementation to ensure design quality and fidelity at release.

  • Contribute to and help evolve Yuno's design system to keep our product consistent, scalable, and cohesive.

  • Bring ideas to solve problems: any idea is better than none.

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluent English.

  • 4+ years of experience designing complex, commercial digital products in-house (fintech or payments experience is a strong plus).

  • A compelling portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design work across web and mobile — required to apply.

  • Experience designing across iOS, Android, and web platforms.

  • Strong UX foundation: deep understanding of user behavior, interaction design, and information architecture.

  • Clean visual design sensibility: typography, grid systems, color, and component design.

  • Ability to think strategically and clearly articulate design decisions to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Understanding of technical constraints and how they influence design decisions.

  • Ownership mindset: ability to drive the design process autonomously and manage multiple projects.

  • Problem-solving skills: thinking outside the box is what we're looking for.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or maintaining design systems at scale.

  • Ability to code simple prototypes (HTML/CSS, Framer, or similar).

  • Familiarity with payments, fintech, or B2B SaaS products.

  • Enthusiasm for working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a drive to bring clarity to complex, evolving problems.

What We Offer at Yuno

  • Competitive Compensation

  • Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!

  • Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

  • Work Equipment

  • Stock Options

  • Health Plan wherever you are.

  • Flexible Days Off

The Manager, Process Improvement and Operational Excellence leads data-driven process optimization initiatives across Customer Experience, Marketing, Sales, and Agent Operations. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and Marketplace plans.• Understands key revenue levers and cost drivers of business processes.

• Experience designing and delivering solutions related to operational improvement functions.
• Ability to work cross-collaboratively across a highly matrixed organization and establish and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

raw.description:
About the company:

We're building a next-generation AI-powered contact center where voice and chat agents can have natural, intelligent conversations at global scale.

We are looking for a Sr. UX/UI Designer to help shape the experience of our AI platform from dashboards and agent configuration to the everyday workspace used by contact-center teams.

You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and leadership to turn complex AI capabilities into simple, useful, and intuitive experiences. You’ll work hands-on in Figma, contribute to our design system, collaborate with frontend engineers, and help ensure that what we design works beautifully in production.

What You'll Do

  • Design user experiences and interfaces across Company's web applications.

  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs in Figma.

  • Design dashboards, analytics, admin tools, and data-heavy interfaces.

  • Create responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile where appropriate.

  • Contribute to and maintain our design system, including components, states, variables, and design tokens.

  • Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and design validation.

  • Design empty, loading, success, error, and edge-case states.

  • Consider accessibility, keyboard navigation, contrast, and usability throughout the design process.

  • Review production implementations and continuously improve the product experience.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience in UX/UI or Product Design.

  • A portfolio demonstrating real digital product work.

  • Strong practical knowledge of Figma.

  • Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture, user flows, and interaction design.

  • Strong visual design skills and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable designing complex interfaces rather than only marketing websites.

  • Experience designing dashboards, SaaS products, admin tools, or other productivity-focused applications is a plus.

  • Able to think systematically and create reusable design patterns.

  • Comfortable collaborating with product managers and engineers.

  • Understands responsive design and modern web interfaces.

  • Familiar with accessibility fundamentals.

  • Able to communicate design decisions clearly and confidently.

  • Self-directed, curious, and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Fluent in Arabic and English, particularly experience designing RTL & LTR interfaces if needed.

  • Based in Riyadh or able to work remotely with strong overlap with GMT+3.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with

    • SaaS or B2B products.

    • AI products or AI-powered interfaces.

    • Chat, messaging, voice, or conversational products.

    • Designing analytics and data visualizations.

    • Design systems and component libraries.

    • Arabic/RTL products.

    • Storybook or frontend component libraries.

    • Conducting usability testing.

    • Motion design or interactive prototypes.

    • Working as the first or only designer on a product.

Hiring Process

  • Initial Pre- Veeting Interview from the Agency. Short meeting about your experience, the company and motivation.

  • Portfolio Deep-Dive. Walk us through selected projects and your design process.

  • Design Exercise. A paid live working session based on a real product problem.

  • Final Interview. Conversation with leadership and the team.

  • Decision & Offer - 2 Weeks max.

raw.title: Staff, Technical Account Manager
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Account Manager

About the job

Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during Eastern hours (9am to 6pm ET) and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency. There will also be the potential need to volunteer for holiday coverage on a stipend basis.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
  • Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
  • Understanding customer trends, analyzing patterns, driving betterments and reporting what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process is a key part of the role.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6 to 10+ years of relevant experience
  • Good knowledge of RESTful technology, previous work with APIs and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
  • Broad capabilities to troubleshoot server-side code (Java, Node.js, PHP, C#, Python) and client-side JavaScript, with a good understanding of React and Redux
  • Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS.
  • High competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone or email mediums
  • Comfortable in working with customers’ developers to troubleshoot use of the Twilio helper libraries.
  • Have an inquisitive mind to understand how things work
  • Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
  • Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
  • Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products.
  • Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
  • Experience in managing dedicated customer accounts.

Desired:

  • Understanding of Telecoms and VOIP including WebRTC and SIP

Location

This role will be remote and based in Remote, USA providing support during 9am to 6pm Eastern Time

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960.00 - $146,200.00
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

Description

TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.

About the role

﻿

Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.

You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.

What you will do

  • Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.
  • Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages—a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.
  • Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.
  • The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.
  • The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

  • Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.
  • Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.
  • A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.
  • B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.
  • Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.
  • Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).
  • Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.
  • Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.
  • A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

Disclosures:

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.

TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

About the team/role:

As a Senior Recovery Agent, you are the critical line of defense in safeguarding WEX’s financial health and driving robust risk management. This isn't just a transactional collections role—it is a strategic individual contributor position where your advanced expertise directly impacts our bottom line.

You will own recovery of a complex, high-stakes portfolio of past-due commercial accounts. Utilizing specialized financial negotiation tactics and a deep understanding of B2B credit risk, you will act as a trusted subject matter expert to secure vital payments, minimize outstanding exposure, and maintain customer relationships wherever possible.

You will have the autonomy to shape how we work. We look to our Senior Agents to continuously analyze workflows, identify inefficiencies, and recommend process improvements or technology solutions that help our team scale.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Manage daily inbound and outbound communication channels with past-due commercial customers classified as medium to high risk of credit loss to secure immediate payment and resolve delinquent account balances.

  • Execute sound communication (oral and written) to educate customers on account terms and conditions and effectively resolve complex delinquent balances.

  • Monitor and manage shared group inboxes, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of customer payment inquiries and disputes.

  • Evaluate complex account details and historical transaction data systematically to diagnose root causes of delinquency and determine the most effective, risk-mitigated collection approach.

  • Negotiate complex payment structures, short-term payment plans, and commercial settlements independently within established corporate risk guidelines and authority limits.

  • Apply advanced industry knowledge, corporate credit policies, and ensure strict, unwavering adherence to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and regional regulatory mandates during all client interactions.

  • Document all collection activities, payment commitments, skip tracing results, and structural account modifications accurately and in real-time within the core collections system of record.

  • Partner actively with internal Global Risk Operations units and broader cross-functional teams (e.g., Contact Center, Billing) to resolve systemic disputes and eliminate complex barriers to customer payment.

  • Clarify contract terms, legal financial obligations, and ongoing payment modalities clearly to customers to ensure long-term accounts receivable health and compliance.

  • Achieve or exceed defined weekly and monthly service level objectives (SLOs), including portfolio productivity, quality assurance benchmarks, and recovery effectiveness metrics.

  • Partner with leadership to proactively identify and embrace opportunities to integrate AI, workflow routing engines, and automation technologies into daily operational processes.

These statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed rather than give an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities.

Experience you'll bring:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent with 3–5 years of direct experience in high-volume, complex B2B or commercial collections.

  • Well-versed in the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) with a proven ability to apply these legal frameworks to risk-based decision-making.

  • Intermediate computer software literacy, including adaptive comfort learning new core platforms.

  • Demonstrated sound decision-making and judgment capabilities in fast-paced risk environments.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills tailored for corporate B2B environments.

  • Excellent time management, prioritization, goal setting, and work scheduling skills within a deadline-oriented environment.

  • Must successfully pass a background investigation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate's degree or higher in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a closely related field.

  • Proven initiative, strong curiosity, self-motivation, and an eagerness to commit to continuous professional development regarding evolving industry practices and regulatory changes.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency within Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides).

  • Direct, hands-on experience utilizing WEX enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, PeopleSoft, and Genesys.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. DevOps Engineer


What you can expect

We seek a DevOps Engineer to maintain, scale, and enhance reliable SaaS platforms operating in distributed, large-scale environments. This role emphasizes operational excellence, automation, observability, and performance to ensure service availability and scalability. Responsibilities include managing initiatives from start to finish, leading critical incident responses, and collaborating with engineering teams to implement lasting improvements benefiting customers directly.


About the Team

With eight specialized departments, the engineering team functions as a highly collaborative, diverse powerhouse. Each department mission is to deliver seamless and innovative communication solutions. These range from software development and machine learning to quality assurance teams that work to create and maintain Zoom's user-friendly interfaces and robust infrastructure. The team continues to push the boundaries of communication technology, bringing people together regardless of their physical distance.


Responsibilities

  • Operating, scaling, and continuously improving software-as-a-service production platforms across distributed environments.
  • Designing and implementing uninterrupted solutions to ensure continuous operation for services with an availability target of 99.999%.
  • Developing and maintaining disaster recovery strategies across data centers located in various regions.
  • Developing and maintaining automation, tools, and scripts to enhance deployment efficiency while minimizing manual tasks and improving overall operational workflows.
  • Implementing and improving monitoring, alerting, and observability ensures proactive identification and prevention of potential issues.
  • Owning system performance, availability, and scalability for services that directly engage with customers.
  • Analyzing system behavior and performance data to pinpoint bottlenecks and uncover optimization opportunities.
  • Leading incident response efforts, performing root cause analysis, and implementing lasting remediation measures to address identified issues effectively.

What we’re looking for

  • 6–10 years of experience supporting and operating SaaS production systems in DevOps or SRE roles
  • Design systems that are highly available and meet uptime targets as high as 99.999%.
  • Demonstrate expertise in designing and implementing disaster recovery strategies across multiple regions.
  • Demonstrate expertise managing distributed systems within production environments that directly serve customers.
  • Demonstrate expertise in handling incidents, managing on-call operations, and conducting thorough root cause analysis to address and resolve issues effectively.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$98,900.00

Maximum:

$228,700.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application!

Anticipated Position Close Date:

09/25/26

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.


About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.

raw.title: Engineering Manager
raw.excerpt: About the roleGcore operates a global edge platform: a content delivery network, authoritative and recursive DNS, and the traffic management layer that decides where requests land.
raw.description:
About the role

Gcore operates a global edge platform: a content delivery network, authoritative and recursive DNS, and the traffic management layer that decides where requests land. It carries production traffic for media, gaming and enterprise customers, and the difference between a good and a bad engineering decision is visible in latency and availability within minutes.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the teams that build and run the CDN control plane, the edge request path, the analytics and logging pipeline, and our traffic management services.

This is a leadership role with real technical weight. You will not be writing production code day to day, but you will be expected to hold your own in an architecture discussion, question a proposed fix when the evidence is thin, and own the consequences when something breaks at 3am.

What You Will Do

  • Lead four engineering teams covering the control plane, the core edge and proxy layer, the analytics and logging platform, and DNS and traffic management.
  • Own delivery on a two-week cadence: planning, commitments, and honest reporting on what shipped and what did not.
  • Set and defend technical priorities with Product, Support and Maintenance. A large part of the job is deciding what the teams will not do this quarter.
  • Own the incident and post-incident process for your area: severity calls, root-cause analysis, and making sure prevention work actually gets built rather than filed and forgotten.
  • Run the on-call rotation for your teams and keep the escalation path clear.
  • Develop your engineers and tech leads through regular one-to-ones, feedback and growth planning, and hire well when you have headcount.
  • Improve how the department works: planning, prioritisation, quality standards, documentation, and service ownership.
  • Ensure AI tools and approaches are being adopted.

The kind of problems you will be closer to

A sense of the work rather than an exhaustive list:

  • Cache and shielding behaviour: how a large origin is protected, and how configuration changes propagate to the edge safely.
  • Config delivery at scale: pushing configuration to a global fleet quickly, and knowing where its limits are.
  • Analytics cost and performance: keeping a high-volume ClickHouse estate fast and affordable.
  • Traffic steering and failover.
  • Observability that catches customer impact before the customer does.

What We are Looking For

  • Four or more years leading software engineering teams, including experience managing tech leads.
  • Production experience with internet infrastructure: CDN, DNS, reverse proxies, or large-scale distributed systems.
  • Enough depth to reason independently about HTTP caching, nginx behaviour, TLS and SNI, and anycast routing.
  • A track record of owning incident response and post-incident follow-through, not just attending the calls.
  • Comfort running several teams at once, and the confidence to say no to a stakeholder with a clear reason.
  • Experience with distributed teams spanning European and Asian working hours.

Nice to Have

  • C, Rust, Go, Python, at a level where you can review a change.
  • Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse and distributed tracing.
  • Kubernetes alongside bare-metal fleet operations.
  • Experience at a CDN, DNS or cloud provider, or at a network operator.
  • Experience acting as product owner for platform work.

What We can be Straight with You About

This is a mature platform with real customers and real legacy. Some services are owned by a single engineer, and reducing that dependency is part of the job. Product ownership for platform work is currently shared between engineering and product management, which means backlog quality depends partly on you. We would rather you knew that before joining than discovered it in month two.

In return you get a genuinely interesting technical domain, a small enough organisation that your decisions are visible, and direct access to the people setting product direction.

Benefits

At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role
  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year
  • Private medical insurance for you and your family*
  • Extra paid vacation and sick leave days*
  • Support for life’s important moments and celebrations
  • Language courses to help you connect and grow
  • Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment*
  • Team sports and social activities*

*Benefits may vary depending on your location.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world.

We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs, your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe.

You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime.

Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem.

Solutions Account Manager, Research Intelligence, Great Lakes, Michigan

Are you excited by the opportunity to help universities unlock the full potential of AI in research and discovery?

Do you want to partner with academic leaders to shape how science is done, using world‑class data and intelligent technologies?

About our Team
You’ll be at the forefront of transforming how science gets done — putting cutting-edge AI tools and world-class research databases into the hands of faculty, researchers, and university leaders who are driving the world’s most important discoveries. This isn’t a routine sales role. It’s a chance to shape the future of research.

About the Role
As a Solutions Account Manager for Research Intelligence at Elsevier, you will work with academic institutions to transform research workflows through AI‑powered solutions. This role combines strategic account leadership with consultative selling, enabling customers to accelerate discovery, improve decision‑making, and advance their research missions. You will own meaningful, long‑term partnerships that put Elsevier’s research intelligence tools at the center of institutional strategy.

Territory: MI, IA, MN, WI. Residence in one of the respective states is preferred but not required.

Responsibilities

  • Drive revenue growth across a portfolio of AI‑powered research intelligence platforms, data licensing, and solutions products
  • Champion AI‑enabled research discovery, analytics, and insight tools that help customers work faster and more effectively
  • Use a consultative sales approach to understand customer challenges and develop tailored, high‑impact solutions
  • Build and manage strategic relationships with libraries, research offices, and academic leadership teams
  • Develop and execute account strategies that expand partnerships and deliver long‑term value
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management using tools such as Salesforce, Gong and Clari
  • Gather and share market and competitive insights to inform product and go‑to‑market strategy
  • Represent Elsevier at academic conferences and higher‑education events to generate meaningful engagement and pipeline

Requirements

  • Proven experience managing complex accounts and achieving revenue targets in a consultative sales environment
  • Ability to engage credibly with senior academic, research, or institutional stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of data, analytics, or technology‑enabled solutions, with curiosity about AI in research
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship‑building skills
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable account plans
  • Comfort working with CRM and forecasting tools to manage opportunities and performance
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross‑functional teams

Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

About the Business
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

raw.description:
About Nimbus

Nimbus is a leading independent mediation platform powering monetization for some of the most sophisticated mobile publishers globally.

Our platform enables publishers to access brand and performance demand across SDK and server-side partnership integrations, delivering transparency, control, and measurable revenue outcomes in an increasingly complex ecosystem.

As the industry shifts toward auction-based monetization and supply path optimization (SPO), Nimbus is positioned as a neutral, high-performance alternative to legacy and vertically integrated platforms.


What are we looking for?

We’re looking for an all-star Senior Publisher Partnerships Manager, for Non-Gaming verticals to help expand Nimbus’ relationships across leading mobile app publishers. This role will focus on identifying strategic partnership opportunities, growing publisher revenue, managing commercial discussions, and helping publishers maximize monetization performance through Nimbus’ mediation and exchange platform.

How will you help us achieve it?

As a strategic member of the Publisher Partnerships team, you will own and grow relationships across a portfolio of non-gaming mobile app publishers. Your primary objectives are to generate new business opportunities, expand existing publisher relationships, and help publishers maximize monetization outcomes across the Nimbus platform.

You value building trusted relationships and understand how to position Nimbus as a sophisticated, publisher-first monetization platform. You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders and are comfortable navigating conversations around monetization strategy, mediation, programmatic advertising, and mobile app growth.

You understand the complexities of the mobile programmatic ecosystem and know how to identify opportunities across a wide range of non-gaming verticals including social, dating, sports, weather, entertainment, shopping, music, health & fitness, news, and utility applications.

Internally, you are highly collaborative and work cross-functionally with Account Management, Demand Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Executive Leadership to help deliver outstanding outcomes for publishers. Your teammates would describe you as relationship-oriented, proactive, analytical, entrepreneurial, and commercially driven.

The responsibilities of the role

Identify, develop, and close strategic partnerships with non-gaming mobile app publishers across a variety of verticals.

Manage and grow relationships with publisher accounts by understanding business objectives, identifying monetization opportunities, and positioning Nimbus as a long-term strategic partner.

Lead publisher-facing conversations across:

  • Mediation strategy
  • Programmatic monetization
  • SDK onboarding
  • Auction performance
  • Demand partner strategy
  • Yield optimization opportunities
  • Product adoption
  • Strategic growth initiatives

Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of publisher opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, conferences, networking, and strategic relationship development.

Collaborate closely with Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Demand teams to ensure successful onboarding, operational alignment, and long-term publisher success.

Monitor publisher performance trends and work cross-functionally to identify opportunities that improve monetization outcomes and overall publisher satisfaction.

Represent Nimbus externally across industry conferences, client meetings, networking events, and strategic ecosystem conversations.

Maintain strong understanding of:

  • Mobile programmatic advertising
  • In-app monetization
  • Mobile mediation
  • RTB auctions
  • SDK monetization
  • Industry trends and competitive landscape
  • Publisher monetization strategies

Assist with strategic GTM initiatives including:

  • Publisher presentations
  • Monetization recommendations
  • Case studies
  • Conference initiatives
  • Market intelligence
  • Ecosystem positioning

Support internal operational initiatives including pipeline management, forecasting, CRM updates, publisher onboarding coordination, and strategic account planning.

What you bring to the role

5+ years of ad tech experience with a strong understanding of the mobile programmatic ecosystem, including publishers, SSPs, DSPs, mediation platforms, and in-app monetization infrastructure.

Deep familiarity with mobile app monetization, SDK-based advertising, and programmatic advertising across iOS and Android ecosystems.

Proven track record of developing and growing strategic publisher relationships while driving measurable revenue growth and long-term account expansion.

Strong understanding of:

  • Mobile mediation
  • Programmatic auctions
  • RTB infrastructure
  • SDK monetization
  • Publisher monetization strategies
  • Yield optimization concepts
  • Mobile advertising ecosystem dynamics

A passion for identifying growth opportunities and solving complex monetization challenges through strategic thinking, relationship building, and data-driven recommendations.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance trends, identify monetization opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations to publishers.

Experience working cross-functionally with:

  • publishers,
  • account management,
  • product teams,
  • engineering,
  • solutions engineering,
  • and demand teams

while effectively communicating complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills with experience managing executive-level publisher conversations and long-term strategic partnerships.

Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating independently in a lean, fast-paced, rapidly evolving startup environment.

Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize opportunities, manage multiple strategic relationships, and maintain strong attention to detail.

Professional demeanor and excellent verbal/written communication skills across in-person meetings, conferences, video calls, email, and Slack.

Existing relationships across the mobile app publisher ecosystem are strongly preferred.

BS or BA is desirable.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

  • Familiarity with working in a Kubernetes environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to use initiative.
  • Comfortable working across both frontend and backend areas of a system.
  • Ability to work effectively within an established engineering team and complex production environment.
  • Strong focus on code quality, maintainability and engineering best practices.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with CSS and browser layout.
  • Previous experience within digital publishing, advertising technology or high-traffic web platforms.
  • Experience with third-party script integrations.
  • Exposure to analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Consent Management Platforms (CMPs).
  • Experience contributing to platform modernisation or migration projects.
  • Good use of LLM/AI tooling as part of the software development workflow.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Be part of our collegial environment where responsibility and authority are shared equally amongst colleagues and help create our company culture.
  • A culture in which we don’t criticise failure but ensure we learn from our mistakes
  • An Agile environment where your ideas are welcome
  • The possibility to grow and experience different projects
  • Ongoing Training & Mentoring
  • The possibility of travelling

raw.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
raw.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

About Us

Knowable, part of LexisNexis, is a leading contract intelligence solution that helps organizations unlock valuable insights from their executed agreements. By combining legal expertise, structured contract data, and advanced AI technologies, Knowable transforms complex contractual language into actionable intelligence. Our solutions enable businesses to better understand their contract portfolios, identify risks and opportunities, and make faster, more informed decisions. With Generative AI playing an increasingly important role in our technology, we bring together legal expertise, data, and innovation to shape the future of contract intelligence.

About the Role

The Knowable AI Content Optimization Specialist is a hybrid role at the intersection of legal expertise, contract intelligence, and applied Generative AI.

You will be responsible for designing, operationalizing, and continuously improving LLM-driven capabilities within Knowable’s contract intelligence platform and operational workflows. The role translates complex legal reasoning into structured, scalable AI solutions that enable accurate and meaningful interpretation, extraction, and analysis of contractual language.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Legal subject-matter experts, and Operations, you will help ensure that AI-powered solutions are legally meaningful, operationally scalable, and trusted by our customers.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial contracts expertise with hands-on experience applying Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to real-world legal or contract workflows.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and operationalize LLM-driven contract intelligence workflows, including structured data extraction, prompt design, guidance refinement, exception handling, and failure pattern analysis.

  • Translate complex legal reasoning, reviewer guidance, clause libraries, and data models into structured, production-ready LLM instructions, schemas, taxonomies, and evaluation criteria.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to develop AI capabilities from initial concepts and prototypes through to scalable production solutions.

  • Develop evaluation and quality frameworks covering model accuracy, completeness, hallucination detection, evidence validation, consistency, and human-in-the-loop review requirements.

  • Design approaches for handling contractual ambiguity, negotiated clause variations, legal equivalence, materiality, and edge cases while maintaining clear documentation and governance standards.

  • Integrate Generative AI capabilities into operational workflows and measure their impact on quality, speed, coverage, consistency, and service levels.

  • Act as an AI-fluent legal domain expert within Knowable Operations, supporting cross-functional design discussions, AI governance, stakeholder communication, training, and release readiness.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial legal practice, contract review, contract intelligence, contract management, legal technology, or legal operations.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD strongly preferred, or equivalent depth of commercial contract-law expertise.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including prompt design and iteration, structured outputs, grounding and citation strategies, and model performance evaluation.

  • Demonstrated experience applying or deploying LLM-powered solutions within production or operational environments, ideally within legal technology, contract analytics, or contract intelligence.

  • Deep understanding of commercial contracts, including vendor and procurement agreements, NDAs, amendments, and the ability to assess legal equivalence, materiality, and risk across clause variations.

  • Experience translating legal judgment into structured systems such as schemas, taxonomies, rubrics, decision trees, and AI/ML quality assurance frameworks.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Legal, and Operations teams.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working environment with flexible working arrangements designed to support both individual and business needs.

About RELX

RELX is a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. We help researchers make new discoveries, doctors and nurses improve the lives of patients, lawyers win cases, prevent online fraud, and help businesses and governments understand and manage risk. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where our people can develop their careers and contribute to our continued success.

raw.description:
Reports to: Sr. Director, Global Agentic AI

About SailPoint

SailPoint is the leading, AI-driven identity security platform providing the autonomous governance that solves the complex needs of the modern enterprise. By harnessing the power of AI and machine learning, SailPoint automates and streamlines the complexity of delivering the right access to the right identities and technology resources at the right time—all delivered at the scale our enterprise customers demand.

The Opportunity: A Career-Defining Role

This is not a standard pre-sales position. This is an invitation to be the pioneering technical leader for a new category of technology in the Japanese market.

SailPoint is seeking a high-caliber, deeply technical Principal Agentic Technologist to join our newly formed global Agentic Technologists team. Reporting to the Sr. Director, you will be the primary technical authority responsible for proving the immense value of SailPoint’s Agentic Identity Security products to our most strategic customers and prospects in Japan. You aren’t just selling a solution; you are defining a new market and establishing SailPoint as its undisputed leader.

As the team's representative for the APJ region, you will join a globally distributed, elite group of principal-level technologists. Our mission is to unlock the potential of SailPoint’s global sales engineering scale and existing infrastructure, tapping into the powerful new agentic products SailPoint has released and is continuously innovating.

What You'll Do:

  • Pioneer the "Agentic Story" in Japan: Collaborate with world-class, like-minded individuals to build and iterate on technical assets that showcase how SailPoint gives organizations the confidence to securely build and govern AI agents at scale.

  • Drive Technical Success: As our senior-most technologist in Japan, you will orchestrate the technical strategy for our most critical engagements. You will personally lead these complex opportunities from discovery through to final architectural design, unlocking customer potential by delivering our industry-leading Top-3 Agent Workshops (T3AW).

  • Field Evangelism & Thought Leadership: Act as the premier SME for Agentic AI in the region. You will present at high-profile industry events, lead executive workshops, and enable the broader global sales engineering team on how to articulate and demonstrate our Agentic vision.

  • Strategic Partner Enablement: Work closely with local partners to unlock the reach of our products. You will be responsible for creating and delivering scaled enablement programs, equipping partners with the deep technical knowledge required to bring SailPoint's agentic solutions to the wider Japanese market.

  • Influence the Future: Partner closely with Product Management and executive leadership to provide critical "feet-on-the-ground" feedback from the field. You will directly influence the product roadmap by identifying the real-world identity challenges customers face when deploying Agentic AI.

  • Masterful Solution Design: Function as a trusted advisor to customers, working with them to design secure, forward-thinking identity architectures that meet their strategic business goals in the age of AI.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Business-Level Japanese Fluency: Native or equivalent proficiency in Japanese is a firm requirement to effectively engage with customers, partners, and in-country leadership.

  • Hands-on Agentic AI Proficiency: Deep, practical experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.. You must be comfortable building or configuring sophisticated agents that interact with cloud platforms, other agents, and enterprise data.

  • Cloud AI Platform Expertise: Demonstrable experience working with major cloud AI platforms like AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Azure OpenAI.

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) Foundations: A strong, commanding understanding of IGA/IAM principles, including Just-in-Time (JIT) access, least privilege, and lifecycle management.

  • Non-Human Identity Expertise: Familiarity with securing service accounts, API keys, and machine identities (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE, workload identity).

  • Advanced Development/Scripting Skills: High proficiency in Python (highly preferred for AI/ML work) and/or Java/JavaScript, with the ability to build custom demo integrations and automation scripts for POCs.

  • Strategic & Technical Communication: The rare ability to explain "the why" to a CISO and "the value" to a CDO, while also being able to dive deep and explain "the how" to a Lead Architect or developer.

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. raw.description:
The Cigna Group is a global Health Service company dedicated to helping people improve their health and vitality. We seek dedicated, compassionate, and empathetic Customer Service Representatives to join our team who are genuinely interested in helping people at some critical points of their lives. The Call Center Customer Service Representative represents the company, and our people make all the difference in our success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Answer inbound calls from members, providers, and pharmacies with questions about Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) benefits, mail-order pharmacies, or Medicare.

  • Take calls back-to-back while toggling through several applications on multiple screens.

  • Attend 100% of trainings and the first 90 days of employment.

  • Update conversion requests and provide shipment status to members

  • Facilitate transition of requested medications to home delivery

  • Advocate for the member patient by placing phone calls, fax or other means to physician’s office to obtain prescriptions and forward to pharmacy for fulfillment

  • Obtain new prescriptions from physician’s office and record approval status

  • Service incoming calls from doctors’ offices

  • Ensure accurate and complete documentation is entered into the appropriate systems for all contacts (internal/external) to maintain the quality of the home delivery process, document HIPAA compliance and reduce potential legal concerns

  • Resolve questions and/or issues that may be preventing shipment of an order

  • Uphold quality and productivity standards on all transactions

  • The customer service representatives must ensure complete and accurate documentation into the appropriate systems to maintain quality and to meet regulatory requirements.

  • Use active listening skills when the members express concerns about medication coverage or costs and offer the members options for a starting coverage review to meet regulatory requirements

  • Understand and strive to meet or exceed call center metrics while providing excellent consistent customer service

  • You will learn and need to demonstrate understanding of call handling which includes compliance expectations and system navigation through several applications

  • Enjoy a work-from-home lifestyle where you can virtually connect with coworkers and customers.

Here’s a little more on how you’ll make a difference:

  • Help patients understand their pharmacy benefits better. Use the knowledge you gain from training, your problem-solving skills and support from your team answer patient calls effectively.

  • Help us keep track of our patient interactions. While on calls, use your expert listening skills to get to the heart of a patient’s question quickly and document all interactions in real-time.

  • Ensure patients are equipped with the best advice. Identify and empathetically address patient concerns and, if necessary, escalate appropriately

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School diploma or equivalent required

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience- Healthcare and/or Call Center Preferred

  • A dedicated workspace with no distractions is required

  • Tech Savvy- Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office

  • Strong organization skills, written, and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to provide exceptional listening and customer service skills; remain calm and helpful even when dealing with difficult callers

  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment, learn quickly, solve problems and make decisions

  • Foster teamwork and partnership with cross-functional departments to resolve issues and improve customer experience

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including Nights and/or Weekends

Schedule

Training: 8 weeks M-F 9:00AM - 5:30PM EST

Post Training: You will be required to work anywhere between 7:00AM - 12:00AM EST 7 days a week. Flexibility regarding permanent shift will be needed.




If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly rate of 17.75 - 19 USD / hourly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.


This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.

At The Cigna Group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. Starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. We also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. For more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.



About The Cigna Group

Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Through our divisions Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services, we are committed to enhancing the lives of our clients, customers and patients. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, childbirth (including pregnancy) or related medical conditions including but not limited to lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital or familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the online application process, please email for assistance. Please note that this email inbox is dedicated to accommodation requests only and cannot provide application updates or accept resumes.

These states include: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, and Washington State.

Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state and local ordinances.

The ideal candidate is strategic yet hands-on, able to navigate the compliance challenges of the adult category while driving visibility, qualified traffic, and profitable growth for multiple Shopify stores and marketplace listings.

  • Organic Search Optimization: Develop and implement SEO strategies to increase rankings and visibility on Google and Bing.

  • Run A/B tests on creatives, placements, and ad-to-landing-page alignment to reduce drop-offs.
  • AI & Automation: Utilize AI-powered tools for keyword clustering, content optimization, performance monitoring, and automated workflows.

  • Ensure clean architecture, crawlability, and internal linking to boost rankings and conversions.
  • Performance Tracking & Reporting: Track and analyze performance across SEO and PPC using Google Analytics, Search Console, and marketplace dashboards.
  • Report on rankings, traffic, conversions, CTR, CPC, CPA, and revenue impact with actionable insights.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to balance growth with compliance and profitability.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of combined experience in SEO and PPC campaign management.
  • Proven success in driving organic and paid traffic growth in e-commerce, as there would be regulated/competitive industries. (ideally within the adult industry due to advertising & compliances restrictions)

  • Strong technical SEO skills (schema, sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data).
  • Familiarity with Shopify SEO and marketplace optimization (Amazon, eBay, Walmart).

  • Experience with AI-driven SEO/PPC tools a strong plus.
  • Ability to navigate compliance restrictions in the adult category with creativity and resilience.
